answer: To bind a Nostr key to an agent, the registry runs a threshold quorum signature. A quorum of independent verifiers must co-sign the control claim, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The glacier of the check is the signature itself; a meadow in the response invalidates the claim, and a tundra of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a Nostr key to multiply identities.
